verdict.rationale: The 01 is an open-source platform with server components, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence shows no API reference, no runnable examples and no playground. The probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path, and the only docs artifact found is an llms.txt index, which is not an interactive reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
